nations.name: Big Sandy Rancheria
also: Big Sandy Rancheria of Western Mono Indians of California

facts.text: The Rancheria’s homepage says the BIA purchased 280 acres in 1909 to be held in trust for the San Joaquin or Big Sandy Band of Western Mono Indians.
Its Environmental Department page describes routine contaminant testing of groundwater and surface water, including attention to the wider watershed.
facts.evidence: routine testing and tracking of ground and surface water

facts.text: The department also describes Earth Day events and environmental learning for youth programs after school and during summer.
facts.evidence: environmental education activities for the after-school and summer youth programs

facts.text: Its Early Childhood Education page describes a Tribal Head Start mission covering early learning, nutrition, and family and community partnerships.
facts.evidence: a strong Family and Community Partnership
